iOS: Fixed Watch Sources on iPad so All Sources, size filters, and Settings wrap inside the viewport. TorBox-backed direct addon links now show a distinct addon-ready badge, while only verified torrent/file matches show TorBox Cached. Recognizes Stremio DHT hashes and matches TV episodes by cached filenames instead of unrelated file IDs. Adds privacy-safe source diagnostics and regression tests. Preserves existing playback, addons, Night Mode, subtitles, TorriODB and settings.
